observations.body: While Daniel prays, Gabriel speaks of seventy weeks, an anointed one cut off, a destroyed city, covenant, and sacrifice and offering ceasing midway through a week.
observations.label: An anointed one and the end of sacrifice enter the vision

observations.body: The passage presents prayer, interpretation, measured weeks, anointed one, destruction, covenant, ceased offering, and desolation as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: prayer, interpretation, measured weeks, anointed one, destruction, covenant, ceased offering, and desolation

observations.body: The passage places sacrifice cessation vision beside prayer, interpretation, measured weeks, anointed one, destruction, covenant, ceased offering, and desolation.

payload.posture: Read Daniel 9:20–27 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the compressed timetable and actors are not fully identified within the vision itself
